meta.title: Gradient Structure Laws as Predictors of PEFT Design: Zero-Shot Cross-Architecture Rank Allocation
meta.editor_note: clarity of technical details and sufficiency of experimental studies
meta.platform_requirement: must reply to reviews on Editorial Manager

root_problems.name: block additivity does NOT imply bilinear (norm-squared is block-additive)
uniqueness of gamma vs optimality under a chosen entropy-regularised objective
why |gamma| is used when its sign carries direction
orthogonal reparameterisation assumption vs non-orthogonal LoRA A/B
no true block-wise gamma-guided allocation experiment (Theory group used uniform r=4)
blank images and small training sets instead of real image-text data
cross-architecture evidence thin (LLaVA-1.5 + Qwen2-VL only; Qwen2-VL behaves differently)
statistics and reproducibility (3 seeds; CI spans zero; 30x comparison; NaN attribution; software versions)
zero-shot definition unclear (does it ever access target-model gradients?)
